  "concordance_definition": "The paper aims to compare treatment efficacy from preclinical testing with outcome from clinical trials and investigate whether rodent models are predictive for clinical outcomes of therapeutic agents in human DKD.",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "Most rodent models only exhibit early features of human DKD.",
    "The db/db mouse model is limited by the pathology reflecting early-stage DKD in humans.",
    "Interlaboratory variability potentially caused by dosing, treatment duration, or environmental factors.",
    "Preclinical studies were primarily conducted in T1DM rodent models, whereas clinical trials were performed in patients with T2DM.",
    "The predictive value of an animal model is limited to the disease this model represents.",
    "Similar end-point measurements need to be explored between preclinical studies and clinical trials.",
    "The selection of a preclinical model should also be based on the mechanism of action of the current drug.",
    "The ZDF rat presented with mild proteinuria and mild to moderate glomerular changes, suggesting that the lack of transient beneficial effects of bardoxolone methyl was because the ZDF rats do not display a severe disease phenotype.",
    "The effects of fenofibrate therapy in DKD showed contrasting results depending on whether fenofibrate was tested in a T1DM or a T2DM model of DKD."
  ],
  "funding_conflict": "F.S.E., M.V.Ø., K.F., and L.N.F. are employees of Gubra ApS; N.V. and J.J. are owners of Gubra ApS.",
  "key_numbers": [
    "700 million people projected to have diabetes by year 2045.",
    "Approximately 50% and 25% of patients with ESRD in need of dialysis or kidney transplantation have diabetes in the USA and EU, respectively.",
    "The prevalence of diabetes has reached world-wide epidemic proportions.",
    "DKD is the leading cause of end-stage renal disease (ESRD).",
    "The main renal outcomes of a subset of these clinical trials are summarized in Table 3, with comparison to corresponding data from preclinical studies in rodent models of DKD.",
    "Four recent clinical trials (EMPA-REG OUTCOME, CANVAS, CREDENCE, and DECLARE-TIMI 58) showed that treatment with empaglifozin, canagliflozin, and dapagliflozin, respectively, consistently reduces adverse renal outcomes as well as cardiovascular events.",
    "The best-characterized and most intensively used models are the STZ rat and the db/db mouse, although both models display varying degree of translatability to human disease.",
    "Pharmacological studies in the KK-Akita mouse and KK-Ay mouse have shown translatability to clinical trials.",
    "Patients given bardoxolone methyl had a mean increase in eGFR of 5.5 mL/min/1.73 m2 from a mean baseline eGFR of 22.4 mL/min/1.73 m2.",
    "Patients in the placebo group experienced a decline in mean eGFR of –0.9 mL/min/1.73 m2 from baseline after 48 weeks of treatment."
  ]
